title: Consciousness is admissible continuation under constraint

statements.text: With Miguel Angel Cartagena and Brent Antonson, Kolesnikov co-authors an account in which consciousness is the capacity of a system to continue coherently under constraint, needing persistence, admissibility and differentiated continuation. Loss of consciousness is loss of admissibility, not loss of information.

sources.quote: Loss of consciousness corresponds to loss of admissibility, not loss of information.
